Thanks for helping keep these notes accurate. Azure changes fast, and the limits, SKUs and supported scenarios for Azure Backup, Site Recovery, Azure Migrate and Azure VMware Solution are updated often, so reports are always welcome.

Issues are public, so please leave out subscription and tenant IDs, vault and resource names, IP addresses, server names and customer details.

For exam booking, score or retake problems, contact Microsoft Credentials support instead:

## What Kind of Issue Is This?

<!-- Mark one with an x. -->

- [ ] **Content error:** text, a table, a callout, a diagram or a number such as an SLA, RTO, RPO or limit is wrong
- [ ] **Outdated content:** an Azure service, feature, SKU or limit, or the exam, has changed since this was written
- [ ] **Exam coverage:** the notes don't match the official AZ-305 study guide
- [ ] **Site bug:** search, navigation, diagrams, a broken link or accessibility
- [ ] **Device issue:** something looks wrong or doesn't work on a specific device, browser or screen size
- [ ] **Suggestion:** something could be clearer or easier to study

## Where?

<!-- Paste a link to the page or section. Click the section in the page's Table of Contents, or hover over its heading and click the link icon, then copy the address bar. -->

## What Is Wrong?

<!-- Quote what the notes say, or describe what happened. For a bug or device issue, list the steps to reproduce it. -->
